findings.title: AI crawlers can read your site
findings.message: All 13 checked AI crawlers (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, Google-Extended, and more) are allowed in robots.txt.

findings.title: Only 31% of images have alt text
findings.message: 109 out of 157 images on https://seranking.com are missing alt text. AI assistants use alt to understand images. Add descriptive alt attributes.

findings.title: No structured data on this page
findings.message: https://seranking.com/insights.html has no JSON-LD, microdata, or RDFa. Structured data is how AI assistants reliably extract who/what/when about your content. Add at least Organization (site-wide) and Article/Product (per page).

findings.title: Q&A content not marked up as FAQ schema
findings.message: https://seranking.com/api.html has 8 headings written as questions but no FAQPage JSON-LD. Google stopped showing FAQ rich results in 2023, so this no longer helps SERP appearance, but AI assistants still use the structured Q&A pairs when extracting answers. Optional but cheap, and only worth doing if these really are question/answer pairs.

findings.title: No llms.txt found
findings.message: llms.txt is an emerging standard for telling LLMs which pages best represent your site. Very few sites have one today — adding one is a fast credibility signal.

findings.title: 67% alt-text coverage
findings.message: 70 of 213 images missing alt. Push coverage above 90%.

findings.title: Heading hierarchy skips levels
findings.message: https://seranking.com jumps heading levels (e.g. h2 directly to h4). A clean h1→h2→h3 hierarchy helps AI assistants understand structure.

findings.title: No <main> or <article> landmark
findings.message: https://seranking.com has neither <main> nor <article>. <header>, <nav>, and <section> are navigational or generic, not content landmarks. Wrap the primary content specifically in <main> (or <article> for a standalone piece) so content extractors can isolate the body from chrome.

findings.title: Outbound links present, authority not verified
findings.message: https://seranking.com/api.html links out to 11 external domains, but none are on our recognised high-authority list (which is deliberately partial). Not penalised. Just sanity-check that the sources you cite are credible.
